title: Soroban Guard Scan API Contract
description: JSON Schema defining the request/response contract for the /scan endpoint

Severity.description: Severity level of a security finding

Finding.description: A security finding from the scan

check_name.description: Identifier for the check/rule that triggered this finding (e.g., 'unchecked-auth', 'integer-overflow')

file_path.description: Relative path to the file containing the issue

line.description: Line number where the issue was detected (1-indexed)

function_name.description: Name of the function containing the issue

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the security issue

remediation.description: Suggested fix or mitigation for the issue (optional)

source.description: Contract source code, GitHub URL, or Soroban contract ID (C-address)

findings.description: List of security findings (empty array if contract is clean)

ErrorResponse.description: Error response shape for all error status codes
